issues.explanation: The printed term is «سنجه (اسم)» with a POS disambiguator, whereas preferred_fa records only «سنجه». Dropping «(اسم)» is standard terminological practice (ISO 10241; the parenthetical is a metalinguistic label, not substantive term content), and the entry for «measure (verb)» strips «(فعل)» by the same logic, so treatment is internally consistent. No correctness issue.
issues.suggested_fix: No change required; if house style demands the printed label, set preferred_fa to «سنجه (اسم)» and likewise «سنجیدن (فعل)» for the verb entry.
